usedFor: Box holds files and folders, and viaSocket utilities adds a wait through “Pause Workflow” before later steps run.

bestTemplate.name: “New File” in Box, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: The pause holds the next step for a set number of minutes after a file lands.

watchOut: “New File” in Box is polling, so the pause begins after a scheduled check, not when the file lands.
